definitions.gloss: water tower; elevated water storage tank
definitions.explanation: A tall structure that holds water at height so that it can be supplied to buildings and water pipes by gravity pressure. A standard element of municipal water supply and of large apartment or industrial complexes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{給水塔|きゅうすいとう}。

examples.english: A water tower stands on top of the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{団地|だんち}→団地：04054_danchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{給水塔|きゅうすいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Older housing complexes always had a water tower.

examples.japanese: {給水塔|きゅうすいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧ことで、⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水圧|すいあつ}→水圧：21749_suiatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: A water tower is a facility that stores water at a high location so that water pressure can be obtained without using pumps.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧ (water supply) and ⟦{塔|とう}→塔：09944_tou⟧ (tower). A tall structure housing an elevated water tank; common in municipal water systems, on factory and apartment-complex roofs, and atop hills.

In Japan, many older ⟦{団地|だんち}→団地：04054_danchi⟧ (public housing complexes) are immediately recognizable by their concrete water towers, which have become a nostalgic architectural motif.
